articles.title: Xi urges decisive progress in advancing Healthy China Initiative
articles.titleCn: 习近平强调推进健康中国建设取得决定性进展
articles.summary: A national conference on health was held in Beijing from Oct. 12 to 13. Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), attended the conference and delivered an important speech. He stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) is crucial to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. China must remain firmly committed to the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and implement guidelines for the health work in the new era. The country should build on its strengths, consolidate foundations, address shortcomings and shore up weak links to promote high-quality development of the health system, continuously improve the health of the people and ensure decisive progress in advancing the Healthy China Initiative.
articles.summaryCn: 习近平在全国卫生大会上强调，要坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路，推动健康中国建设取得决定性进展。

paragraphs.en: A national conference on health was held in Beijing from Oct. 12 to 13. Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), attended the conference and delivered an important speech. He stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) is {{1}} to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. China must remain firmly committed to the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and implement guidelines for the health work in the new era.
paragraphs.cn: 全国卫生大会于10月12日至13日在北京举行。中国国家主席、中共中央总书记、中央军委主席习近平出席会议并发表重要讲话。他强调，第十五个五年规划时期（2026-2030年）对于实现2035年建成健康中国的目标至关重要。中国必须坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路，实施新时代卫生工作方针。

paragraphs.en: The country should build on its strengths, {{2}} foundations, address {{3}} and shore up weak links to promote high-quality development of the health system, continuously improve the health of the people and ensure {{0}} progress in advancing the Healthy China Initiative. Li Qiang made concluding remarks at the conference, which was also attended by Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi. Xi noted that people's health is a key {{4}} of a {{5}} nation and a strong country. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has made safeguarding people's health a {{6}} priority in the country's development. It has established guidelines for the health work in the new era, and made major decisions and arrangements for building a Healthy China.
paragraphs.cn: 国家应发挥优势、夯实基础、补齐短板、加固弱项，推动卫生体系高质量发展，不断增进人民健康，确保健康中国行动取得决定性进展。李强作总结讲话，赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希出席会议。习近平指出，人民健康是民族昌盛和国家强盛的重要标志。党的十八大以来，党中央把保障人民健康放在国家发展的战略优先位置，确立了新时代卫生工作方针，对建设健康中国作出重大决策部署。

paragraphs.en: These efforts have led to the development of the world's largest systems for medical services, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and healthcare security, marking historic achievements and all-round progress in the health sector. We aim to build a Healthy China where balanced, {{7}}, high-quality and {{8}} health services are ensured, Xi said, adding that the country should have strong capacities in health management, disease prevention and control, medical services, medical insurance support, pharmaceutical {{21}} and talent development, so as to effectively meet people's ever-growing health needs and ensure {{9}} and steady improvements in key health indicators. Xi said that the health sector plays an {{10}} and foundational role, and it is necessary to {{11}} implement a strategy that {{12}} health. Safeguarding people's health must be factored into all policies and reflected in every aspect of work. In formulating plans, designing policies, evaluating projects, and carrying out construction, the impact on people's health must always be given top priority, Xi said.
paragraphs.cn: 这些努力推动了世界上规模最大的医疗服务体系、传统医药体系、疾病预防控制体系和医疗保障体系的发展，标志着卫生领域取得历史性成就和全面进步。习近平表示，我们要建设健康中国，确保提供均衡、普惠、优质、高效的卫生服务，并指出国家应在健康管理、疾病预防控制、医疗服务、医保支撑、药品创新和人才培养等方面具备强大能力，以有效满足人民日益增长的健康需求，确保主要健康指标持续稳步提升。习近平指出，卫生领域具有全局性和基础性作用，必须坚定不移实施健康优先战略。保障人民健康必须融入所有政策，体现在各项工作之中。习近平表示，在制定规划、设计政策、评估项目、开展建设时，必须始终把对人民健康的影响放在首位。

paragraphs.en: Emphasizing that prevention is the most cost-effective and efficient health strategy, Xi urged {{13}} efforts to strengthen foundational work concerning public health and healthcare and address health issues at their source, so as to lay a solid foundation for the health of the entire population. He said it is {{14}} to guide the public in developing a correct understanding of health and engaging in effective self-care and health management. Young people should be encouraged to develop good study and lifestyle habits and achieve well-rounded development in terms of moral grounding, intellectual capability, physical vigor, aesthetic sensibility and work skills. Efforts should be made to create a {{15}} ecological, working and living environment, encourage and support fitness for all and healthy leisure activities, and strengthen food safety {{16}} to ensure that every bite of food is safe. Xi also said the disease prevention and control system must be improved to ensure that no large-scale {{17}} occur.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平强调预防是最经济最有效的健康策略，要求细致做好公共卫生和医疗健康基础工作，从源头上解决健康问题，为全体人民健康奠定坚实基础。他表示，必须引导公众树立正确的健康观念，进行有效的自我保健和健康管理。应鼓励青少年养成良好的学习和生活习惯，在道德、智力、体质、审美和劳动技能方面实现全面发展。应努力创造良好的生态、工作和生活环境，鼓励和支持全民健身和健康休闲活动，加强食品安全监管，确保每一口食物都安全。习近平还表示，必须完善疾病预防控制体系，确保不发生大规模疫情。

paragraphs.en: Xi noted that comprehensively improving medical services is a key task in building a Healthy China. It is essential to advance a program aimed at enhancing primary-level healthcare, {{18}} the functions and structural layout of healthcare institutions, and promote tiered diagnosis and treatment, so that people can readily access quality medical care close to home. It is necessary to strengthen comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases, and improve whole-chain services covering prevention, treatment, {{19}} and management. Mechanisms for the {{20}}, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) should be improved to enhance integrated development of TCM and Western medicine. Xi called for efforts to strengthen basic research and original innovation in the health sector, facilitate the {{22}} of scientific and technological achievements into practical applications, and expand and strengthen the health industry.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，全面提高医疗服务水平是建设健康中国的关键任务。必须推进基层医疗健康提升工程，优化医疗机构功能和结构布局，推进分级诊疗，使群众能够就近获得优质医疗服务。要加强慢性病综合防控，完善覆盖预防、治疗、康复和管理的全链条服务。应完善中医药传承创新发展机制，促进中西医结合发展。习近平呼吁加强卫生领域基础研究和原始创新，促进科技成果转化应用，做大做强健康产业。

paragraphs.en: He also said it is necessary to enhance the patient experience, and continuously improve public access to and {{23}} with healthcare services. Xi stressed that reform is a strong driving force for the development of the health sector, and that the {{24}} development and regulation of medical services, medical insurance and {{25}} should be the primary focus of reforming the health system. Efforts must be made to fully implement the reform plan for public health and medical institutions, deepen public hospital reform with a commitment to their public-welfare nature, and provide greater support for the running of community-level healthcare facilities in counties and districts. Measures should be taken to establish a multi-tiered healthcare security system, with optimized policies on centralized procurement of drugs and consumables, medical insurance payments and fund utilization, so as to ensure the safe operation of insurance funds and the sound operation of hospitals, and keep healthcare expenses within an affordable range for the public. Efforts must be made to improve mechanisms for ensuring the supply and management of medicines, refine the national system of essential medicines, and strengthen oversight of pharmaceutical quality and safety.
paragraphs.cn: 他还表示，必须提升患者体验，不断增强群众对医疗服务的可及性和满意度。习近平强调，改革是卫生领域发展的强大动力，医疗服务、医疗保险和医药的协同发展与监管应作为卫生体制改革的主要着力点。必须全面实施公共卫生和医疗机构改革方案，深化公立医院改革，坚持其公益性质，加大对县区基层医疗机构的运行支持。应采取措施建立多层次医疗保障体系，优化药品和耗材集中采购、医保支付和基金使用政策，确保医保基金安全运行和医院良性运转，将医疗费用保持在群众可承受范围内。必须完善药品供应保障和管理机制，完善国家基本药物制度，加强药品质量安全监管。

paragraphs.en: Xi noted that safeguarding people's health requires a strong {{26}} of management and healthcare professionals. It is necessary to select and appoint competent leadership teams at all levels of health authorities and healthcare institutions, their principal heads in particular, and strive to build a medical workforce that is sufficient in number, well-structured, and highly qualified. He also stressed enhancing work ethics and conduct, fostering a sound professional {{27}}, and promoting a social atmosphere of respect for medical professionals and high regard for the health profession. Xi stressed that health for all is a shared aspiration of humanity. It is necessary to actively advance the building of a global community of health for all, join hands to address major challenges in the health sector, and continuously improve the health and well-being of people in all countries.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平指出，保障人民健康需要一支强大的管理和医疗卫生专业队伍。必须选拔任用各级卫生行政部门和医疗机构称职的领导班子，特别是主要负责人，努力建设一支数量充足、结构合理、素质优良的医疗卫生队伍。他还强调要加强职业道德和作风建设，培育良好的行业风气，营造尊医重卫的社会氛围。习近平强调，人人健康是人类的共同追求。必须积极推动构建人类卫生健康共同体，携手应对卫生领域重大挑战，不断增进各国人民健康福祉。

paragraphs.en: Efforts should be made to deepen Belt and Road cooperation in health, strengthen and innovate China's health-related foreign assistance, and tell the story of a Healthy China well to further build international {{28}}. In his concluding remarks, Li Qiang said General Secretary Xi's important speech provides profound answers to a series of fundamental, directional, and overarching issues concerning health work. With great ideological, strategic, and guiding significance, the speech charts the course and provides essential guidelines for advancing China's health sector in the new era and on the new journey. Li called for actions to earnestly study and deeply understand the speech, implement it fully and without compromise, enhance consciousness in both thought and action, and unswervingly follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics. Li stressed the needs to firmly establish a health-first approach to promote the coordinated development of people's health and economic and social progress; uphold the public-welfare nature of basic medical and health services to consolidate the foundation of health for all; place equal emphasis on ensuring basic services and improving quality to better meet people's diverse health needs; and deepen reform, innovation, opening up, and cooperation to continuously boost the driving force and vitality for the health sector's development.
paragraphs.cn: 应努力深化“一带一路”卫生合作，加强和创新中国卫生对外援助，讲好健康中国故事，进一步凝聚国际共识。李强在总结讲话中表示，习近平总书记的重要讲话深刻回答了一系列关于卫生工作的根本性、方向性、全局性问题。讲话具有重大思想性、战略性和指导性，为新时代新征程推进中国卫生事业发展指明了方向、提供了根本遵循。李强要求切实学习贯彻讲话精神，不折不扣全面落实，增强思想和行动自觉，坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路。李强强调，要牢固树立健康优先理念，促进人民健康与经济社会协调发展；坚持基本医疗卫生事业的公益性质，夯实全民健康基础；坚持保基本与提质量并重，更好满足人民多样化健康需求；深化改革、创新、开放、合作，不断增强卫生事业发展的动力和活力。

paragraphs.en: We must focus on the pain points and bottlenecks in the health sector, and give priority to addressing the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people most, Li said. Vigorous efforts should be made to prevent and control major diseases, advance the development of the tiered diagnosis and treatment system, improve people's experience of seeking and receiving medical services, build a multi-tiered healthcare security system, {{29}} the unique strengths of traditional Chinese medicine, improve health services for the elderly and children, and promote the empowerment of the medical and health sector by science and technology, so as to lay a solid foundation for building a Healthy China. Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, vice chairperson of the CMC, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, state councilors, the procurator-general of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and leading officials of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting. Also present at the meeting were leading officials of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, leading officials from relevant central Party and government departments, people's organizations, some state-owned enterprises directly administered by the central government, and relevant departments of the CMC, as well as representatives of experts and scholars.
paragraphs.cn: 李强表示，必须聚焦卫生领域的痛点和瓶颈，优先解决群众最关心最迫切的困难和问题。要大力防控重大疾病，推进分级诊疗制度建设，改善群众看病就医体验，构建多层次医疗保障体系，发挥中医药独特优势，改善老年人和儿童健康服务，推动科学技术对医疗卫生事业的赋能，为建设健康中国奠定坚实基础。出席会议的还有中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中央军委副主席、全国人大常委会领导同志、国务委员、最高人民检察院检察长、全国政协领导同志。参加会议的还有各省、自治区、直辖市及计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团领导同志，中央和国家机关有关部门、人民团体、部分中央管理国有企业、中央军委有关部门负责同志，以及专家学者代表。

A national conference on health was held in Beijing from Oct. 12 to 13. Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), attended the conference and delivered an important speech. He stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) is crucial to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. China must remain firmly committed to the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and implement guidelines for the health work in the new era. The country should build on its strengths, consolidate foundations, address shortcomings and shore up weak links to promote high-quality development of the health system, continuously improve the health of the people and ensure decisive progress in advancing the Healthy China Initiative.
Li Qiang made concluding remarks at the conference, which was also attended by Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi.
Xi noted that people's health is a key indicator of a prosperous nation and a strong country. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has made safeguarding people's health a strategic priority in the country's development. It has established guidelines for the health work in the new era, and made major decisions and arrangements for building a Healthy China. These efforts have led to the development of the world's largest systems for medical services, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and healthcare security, marking historic achievements and all-round progress in the health sector.
We aim to build a Healthy China where balanced, inclusive, high-quality and efficient health services are ensured, Xi said, adding that the country should have strong capacities in health management, disease prevention and control, medical services, medical insurance support, pharmaceutical innovation and talent development, so as to effectively meet people's ever-growing health needs and ensure sustained and steady improvements in key health indicators.
Xi said that the health sector plays an overarching and foundational role, and it is necessary to steadfastly implement a strategy that prioritizes health. Safeguarding people's health must be factored into all policies and reflected in every aspect of work. In formulating plans, designing policies, evaluating projects, and carrying out construction, the impact on people's health must always be given top priority, Xi said.
Emphasizing that prevention is the most cost-effective and efficient health strategy, Xi urged meticulous efforts to strengthen foundational work concerning public health and healthcare and address health issues at their source, so as to lay a solid foundation for the health of the entire population. He said it is imperative to guide the public in developing a correct understanding of health and engaging in effective self-care and health management. Young people should be encouraged to develop good study and lifestyle habits and achieve well-rounded development in terms of moral grounding, intellectual capability, physical vigor, aesthetic sensibility and work skills. Efforts should be made to create a favorable ecological, working and living environment, encourage and support fitness for all and healthy leisure activities, and strengthen food safety oversight to ensure that every bite of food is safe. Xi also said the disease prevention and control system must be improved to ensure that no large-scale epidemics occur.
Xi noted that comprehensively improving medical services is a key task in building a Healthy China. It is essential to advance a program aimed at enhancing primary-level healthcare, optimize the functions and structural layout of healthcare institutions, and promote tiered diagnosis and treatment, so that people can readily access quality medical care close to home. It is necessary to strengthen comprehensive prevention and control of chronic diseases, and improve whole-chain services covering prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and management. Mechanisms for the inheritance, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) should be improved to enhance integrated development of TCM and Western medicine. Xi called for efforts to strengthen basic research and original innovation in the health sector, facilitate the translation of scientific and technological achievements into practical applications, and expand and strengthen the health industry. He also said it is necessary to enhance the patient experience, and continuously improve public access to and satisfaction with healthcare services.
Xi stressed that reform is a strong driving force for the development of the health sector, and that the coordinated development and regulation of medical services, medical insurance and pharmaceuticals should be the primary focus of reforming the health system. Efforts must be made to fully implement the reform plan for public health and medical institutions, deepen public hospital reform with a commitment to their public-welfare nature, and provide greater support for the running of community-level healthcare facilities in counties and districts. Measures should be taken to establish a multi-tiered healthcare security system, with optimized policies on centralized procurement of drugs and consumables, medical insurance payments and fund utilization, so as to ensure the safe operation of insurance funds and the sound operation of hospitals, and keep healthcare expenses within an affordable range for the public. Efforts must be made to improve mechanisms for ensuring the supply and management of medicines, refine the national system of essential medicines, and strengthen oversight of pharmaceutical quality and safety.
Xi noted that safeguarding people's health requires a strong contingent of management and healthcare professionals. It is necessary to select and appoint competent leadership teams at all levels of health authorities and healthcare institutions, their principal heads in particular, and strive to build a medical workforce that is sufficient in number, well-structured, and highly qualified. He also stressed enhancing work ethics and conduct, fostering a sound professional ethos, and promoting a social atmosphere of respect for medical professionals and high regard for the health profession.
Xi stressed that health for all is a shared aspiration of humanity. It is necessary to actively advance the building of a global community of health for all, join hands to address major challenges in the health sector, and continuously improve the health and well-being of people in all countries. Efforts should be made to deepen Belt and Road cooperation in health, strengthen and innovate China's health-related foreign assistance, and tell the story of a Healthy China well to further build international consensus.
In his concluding remarks, Li Qiang said General Secretary Xi's important speech provides profound answers to a series of fundamental, directional, and overarching issues concerning health work. With great ideological, strategic, and guiding significance, the speech charts the course and provides essential guidelines for advancing China's health sector in the new era and on the new journey. Li called for actions to earnestly study and deeply understand the speech, implement it fully and without compromise, enhance consciousness in both thought and action, and unswervingly follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics.
Li stressed the needs to firmly establish a health-first approach to promote the coordinated development of people's health and economic and social progress; uphold the public-welfare nature of basic medical and health services to consolidate the foundation of health for all; place equal emphasis on ensuring basic services and improving quality to better meet people's diverse health needs; and deepen reform, innovation, opening up, and cooperation to continuously boost the driving force and vitality for the health sector's development.
We must focus on the pain points and bottlenecks in the health sector, and give priority to addressing the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people most, Li said. Vigorous efforts should be made to prevent and control major diseases, advance the development of the tiered diagnosis and treatment system, improve people's experience of seeking and receiving medical services, build a multi-tiered healthcare security system, leverage the unique strengths of traditional Chinese medicine, improve health services for the elderly and children, and promote the empowerment of the medical and health sector by science and technology, so as to lay a solid foundation for building a Healthy China.
Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, vice chairperson of the CMC, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, state councilors, the procurator-general of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and leading officials of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting.
Also present at the meeting were leading officials of provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government, cities specifically designated in the state plan, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, leading officials from relevant central Party and government departments, people's organizations, some state-owned enterprises directly administered by the central government, and relevant departments of the CMC, as well as representatives of experts and scholars.

习近平强调预防是最经济最有效的健康策略，要求细致做好公共卫生和医疗健康基础工作，从源头上解决健康问题，为全体人民健康奠定坚实基础。他表示，必须引导公众树立正确的健康观念，进行有效的自我保健和健康管理。应鼓励青少年养成良好的学习和生活习惯，在道德、智力、体质、审美和劳动技能方面实现全面发展。应努力创造良好的生态、工作和生活环境，鼓励和支持全民健身和健康休闲活动，加强食品安全监管，确保每一口食物都安全。习近平还表示，必须完善疾病预防控制体系，确保不发生大规模疫情。

习近平指出，全面提高医疗服务水平是建设健康中国的关键任务。必须推进基层医疗健康提升工程，优化医疗机构功能和结构布局，推进分级诊疗，使群众能够就近获得优质医疗服务。要加强慢性病综合防控，完善覆盖预防、治疗、康复和管理的全链条服务。应完善中医药传承创新发展机制，促进中西医结合发展。习近平呼吁加强卫生领域基础研究和原始创新，促进科技成果转化应用，做大做强健康产业。

他还表示，必须提升患者体验，不断增强群众对医疗服务的可及性和满意度。习近平强调，改革是卫生领域发展的强大动力，医疗服务、医疗保险和医药的协同发展与监管应作为卫生体制改革的主要着力点。必须全面实施公共卫生和医疗机构改革方案，深化公立医院改革，坚持其公益性质，加大对县区基层医疗机构的运行支持。应采取措施建立多层次医疗保障体系，优化药品和耗材集中采购、医保支付和基金使用政策，确保医保基金安全运行和医院良性运转，将医疗费用保持在群众可承受范围内。必须完善药品供应保障和管理机制，完善国家基本药物制度，加强药品质量安全监管。

习近平指出，保障人民健康需要一支强大的管理和医疗卫生专业队伍。必须选拔任用各级卫生行政部门和医疗机构称职的领导班子，特别是主要负责人，努力建设一支数量充足、结构合理、素质优良的医疗卫生队伍。他还强调要加强职业道德和作风建设，培育良好的行业风气，营造尊医重卫的社会氛围。习近平强调，人人健康是人类的共同追求。必须积极推动构建人类卫生健康共同体，携手应对卫生领域重大挑战，不断增进各国人民健康福祉。

应努力深化“一带一路”卫生合作，加强和创新中国卫生对外援助，讲好健康中国故事，进一步凝聚国际共识。李强在总结讲话中表示，习近平总书记的重要讲话深刻回答了一系列关于卫生工作的根本性、方向性、全局性问题。讲话具有重大思想性、战略性和指导性，为新时代新征程推进中国卫生事业发展指明了方向、提供了根本遵循。李强要求切实学习贯彻讲话精神，不折不扣全面落实，增强思想和行动自觉，坚定不移走中国特色卫生健康发展道路。李强强调，要牢固树立健康优先理念，促进人民健康与经济社会协调发展；坚持基本医疗卫生事业的公益性质，夯实全民健康基础；坚持保基本与提质量并重，更好满足人民多样化健康需求；深化改革、创新、开放、合作，不断增强卫生事业发展的动力和活力。

李强表示，必须聚焦卫生领域的痛点和瓶颈，优先解决群众最关心最迫切的困难和问题。要大力防控重大疾病，推进分级诊疗制度建设，改善群众看病就医体验，构建多层次医疗保障体系，发挥中医药独特优势，改善老年人和儿童健康服务，推动科学技术对医疗卫生事业的赋能，为建设健康中国奠定坚实基础。出席会议的还有中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中央军委副主席、全国人大常委会领导同志、国务委员、最高人民检察院检察长、全国政协领导同志。参加会议的还有各省、自治区、直辖市及计划单列市、新疆生产建设兵团领导同志，中央和国家机关有关部门、人民团体、部分中央管理国有企业、中央军委有关部门负责同志，以及专家学者代表。

articles.title: Chinese foreign minister meets with his Turkish counterpart
articles.titleCn: 中国外交部长会见土耳其外长
articles.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Thursday in Baku, the capital of Azerbaijan, on the sidelines of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia.
articles.summaryCn: 中国外交部长王毅在阿塞拜疆巴库会见土耳其外长费丹，双方就深化战略合作、经贸投资、气候变化及国际热点问题交换意见。

paragraphs.en:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi (R) shakes hands with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan in Baku, capital of Azerbaijan, October 15, 2026. /Chinese Foreign Ministry
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Thursday in Baku, capital of Azerbaijan, on the {{1}} of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia. Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, said China and Türkiye enjoy a traditional friendship, and deepening {{2}} cooperation between Beijing and Ankara serves the interests of both countries and their peoples and will also contribute to global economic {{3}}. China has always attached great importance to its relations with Türkiye and stands ready to work with Ankara to take the 55th {{4}} of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries as an opportunity to implement the important {{5}} reached by the two heads of state and {{6}} China-Türkiye strategic cooperation to a new level, Wang said. Wang said China {{7}} Türkiye's repeated emphasis on attaching importance to China's security concerns and its efforts in {{8}} terrorist acts that {{9}} China's national security. China hopes Türkiye will continue to understand and support China's position on issues concerning its core interests, {{10}} the common interests of both countries and {{11}} the political foundation of {{12}} relations, Wang said.
paragraphs.cn:
2026年10月15日，在阿塞拜疆首都巴库，中国外交部长王毅（右）与土耳其外长哈坎·费丹握手。/中国外交部
周四，在阿塞拜疆首都巴库举行的亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议第七次峰会期间，中国外交部长王毅会见了土耳其外长哈坎·费丹。王毅也是中共中央政治局委员，他表示中土两国有着传统友谊，深化北京与安卡拉之间的战略合作符合两国和两国人民的利益，也将有助于全球经济复苏。王毅说，中国始终高度重视与土耳其的关系，愿与安卡拉一道，以两国建交55周年为契机，落实两国元首达成的重要共识，推动中土战略合作迈上新台阶。王毅表示，中国赞赏土耳其多次强调重视中国的安全关切，以及在遏制危害中国国家安全的恐怖行为方面所作的努力。王毅说，中国希望土耳其继续理解和支持中国在涉及核心利益问题上的立场，维护两国的共同利益，巩固双边关系的政治基础。

paragraphs.en: Wang said China supports Türkiye in hosting the 31st session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31), appreciates Türkiye's efforts to address climate change and stands ready to deepen cooperation with Türkiye in this field. In the next stage, the two sides should strengthen the {{13}} between the Belt and Road Initiative and the Middle Corridor, create a {{14}} environment for two-way investment and achieve {{15}} {{16}} win-win results, Wang said. Fidan, for his part, said that through the joint efforts of both sides, Türkiye-China relations have continued to develop, and the two countries are working together to address various global challenges. Türkiye attaches great importance to its relations with China and hopes to step up high-level exchanges between the two countries in the next stage, he said. Noting the promising {{17}} for economic and trade relations between the two countries, Fidan said Türkiye welcomes Chinese companies to invest in Türkiye and more Chinese tourists to visit the country and hopes to achieve more {{18}} development across various areas of bilateral cooperation. Türkiye understands China's concerns in {{19}} {{20}} terrorism and will {{21}} to the one-China principle, honor its {{22}} to China and never allow its territory to be used for activities that {{23}} China's security, Fidan said.
paragraphs.cn: 王毅表示，中国支持土耳其主办《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会（COP31），赞赏土耳其应对气候变化的努力，并愿深化与土耳其在该领域的合作。王毅说，下一阶段，双方应加强“一带一路”倡议与“中间走廊”的对接，为双向投资创造有利环境，实现互利共赢。费丹则表示，通过双方共同努力，土中关系持续发展，两国正携手应对各种全球性挑战。他说，土耳其高度重视与中国的关系，希望下一阶段加强两国高层交往。费丹指出两国经贸关系前景广阔，表示土耳其欢迎中国企业赴土投资，欢迎更多中国游客到访，并希望双边合作各领域实现更加平衡的发展。费丹说，土耳其理解中国在打击极端恐怖主义方面的关切，将坚持一个中国原则，履行对华承诺，绝不允许其领土被用于损害中国安全的活动。

paragraphs.en: The two sides also {{24}} views on the current situation in the Middle East, the Ukraine crisis and other international and regional hotspot issues.
paragraphs.cn: 双方还就当前中东局势、乌克兰危机及其他国际和地区热点问题交换了意见。

articles.fullText:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi (R) shakes hands with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan in Baku, capital of Azerbaijan, October 15, 2026. /Chinese Foreign Ministry
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan on Thursday in Baku, capital of Azerbaijan, on the sidelines of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia.
Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, said China and Türkiye enjoy a traditional friendship, and deepening strategic cooperation between Beijing and Ankara serves the interests of both countries and their peoples and will also contribute to global economic recovery.
China has always attached great importance to its relations with Türkiye and stands ready to work with Ankara to take the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries as an opportunity to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and advance China-Türkiye strategic cooperation to a new level, Wang said.
Wang said China appreciates Türkiye's repeated emphasis on attaching importance to China's security concerns and its efforts in curbing terrorist acts that endanger China's national security.
China hopes Türkiye will continue to understand and support China's position on issues concerning its core interests, safeguard the common interests of both countries and consolidate the political foundation of bilateral relations, Wang said.
Wang said China supports Türkiye in hosting the 31st session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31), appreciates Türkiye's efforts to address climate change and stands ready to deepen cooperation with Türkiye in this field.
In the next stage, the two sides should strengthen the synergy between the Belt and Road Initiative and the Middle Corridor, create a favorable environment for two-way investment and achieve mutually beneficial win-win results, Wang said.
Fidan, for his part, said that through the joint efforts of both sides, Türkiye-China relations have continued to develop, and the two countries are working together to address various global challenges.
Türkiye attaches great importance to its relations with China and hopes to step up high-level exchanges between the two countries in the next stage, he said.
Noting the promising prospects for economic and trade relations between the two countries, Fidan said Türkiye welcomes Chinese companies to invest in Türkiye and more Chinese tourists to visit the country and hopes to achieve more balanced development across various areas of bilateral cooperation.
Türkiye understands China's concerns in combating extreme terrorism and will adhere to the one-China principle, honor its commitments to China and never allow its territory to be used for activities that undermine China's security, Fidan said.
The two sides also exchanged views on the current situation in the Middle East, the Ukraine crisis and other international and regional hotspot issues.

articles.title: How AI is redefining precision farming in China
articles.titleCn: 人工智能如何重新定义中国的精准农业
articles.summary: How AI is redefining precision farming in China
articles.summaryCn: 人工智能正推动中国农业从经验驱动转向数据驱动，在育种、田间管理和智能农机等方面取得显著成效，但粮食安全还需确保农民共享创新收益。

paragraphs.en: "Innovation Today, Food Security Tomorrow" is the theme for the 46th World Food Day, which takes place on Friday. As artificial intelligence (AI) moves from laboratories to fields, China's agriculture sector is {{2}} a shift from experience-driven to data-driven farming. AI is {{3}} advances in seed breeding. The "Shennong Guxin" intelligent breeding model developed by China Agricultural University {{4}} {{5}} data with agricultural knowledge graphs, drawing on tens of millions of data entries. The model has shortened breeding cycles by more than 30%, reducing the time needed to develop new varieties from the {{6}} five to eight years to two to three years.
paragraphs.cn: “今天创新，明天粮食安全”是周五举行的第46个世界粮食日的主题。随着人工智能（AI）从实验室走向田间，中国农业部门正经历从经验驱动向数据驱动耕作的转变。AI正在加速种子育种的进步。中国农业大学开发的“神农固芯”智能育种模型将基因型数据与农业知识图谱相结合，利用数千万条数据条目。该模型将育种周期缩短了30%以上，将开发新品种所需的时间从传统的五到八年减少到两到三年。

paragraphs.en: Two new lettuce varieties developed using the model, Yanqi No. 1 and Yanqi No. 2, have been successfully {{7}} in Huairou District, Beijing, where they have shown strong stress {{8}} and good quality. AI is also making field management more precise. This year, Longquan City in east China's Zhejiang Province {{9}} intelligent pest-{{10}} systems across about 733 hectares of early-season rice fields.
paragraphs.cn: 利用该模型开发的两个新莴苣品种——燕起1号和燕起2号——已在北京怀柔区成功试种，表现出较强的抗逆性和良好品质。AI还使田间管理更加精准。今年，中国东部浙江省龙泉市在约733公顷早季稻田部署了智能病虫害监测系统。

paragraphs.en: Operating around the clock, the systems provide digital monitoring of crop pests and diseases. The {{11}} has reduced pesticide use by 20%, achieved pest-control {{12}} of more than 90% and kept crop losses caused by pests and diseases below 5%. Farmers can use pest {{13}} sent to their phones to guide drones in applying pesticides {{14}} to affected areas. According to the report, this means even people without farming experience can carry out {{15}} pesticide application. Meanwhile, smart agricultural {{16}} is changing how farms are managed.
paragraphs.cn: 这些系统全天候运行，对作物病虫害进行数字化监测。该举措将农药使用量减少了20%，病虫害防治效果超过90%，病虫害造成的作物损失保持在5%以下。农民可以利用发送到手机的病虫害警报，引导无人机精准地对受影响区域施用农药。据报道，这意味着即使没有种植经验的人也能进行有针对性的农药施用。与此同时，智能农业机械正在改变农场的管理方式。

Operating {{23}} are kept within 2.5 {{24}}. The 200-hectare rice farm requires only four people for management, while farmers' {{25}} income can {{26}} 30,000 yuan per hectare.
paragraphs.cn: 新华社2026年6月报道，中国中部河南省的农业机械云平台已连接超过13.8万台机器。在清丰县的一个无人农场，北斗导航使无人驾驶收割机一天能覆盖超过13公顷。7月《科技日报》的一篇报道描述了中国中部湖南省大通湖的一个无人再生稻农场，那里由北斗导航引导的农业机械与数字管理平台协同运作。操作误差控制在2.5厘米以内。这个200公顷的稻田只需四人管理，而农民的净收入每公顷可超过3万元。

"Innovation Today, Food Security Tomorrow" is the theme for the 46th World Food Day, which takes place on Friday. As artificial intelligence (AI) moves from laboratories to fields, China's agriculture sector is undergoing a shift from experience-driven to data-driven farming.
AI is accelerating advances in seed breeding. The "Shennong Guxin" intelligent breeding model developed by China Agricultural University integrates genotypic data with agricultural knowledge graphs, drawing on tens of millions of data entries. The model has shortened breeding cycles by more than 30%, reducing the time needed to develop new varieties from the conventional five to eight years to two to three years. Two new lettuce varieties developed using the model, Yanqi No. 1 and Yanqi No. 2, have been successfully trialed in Huairou District, Beijing, where they have shown strong stress resistance and good quality.
AI is also making field management more precise. This year, Longquan City in east China's Zhejiang Province deployed intelligent pest-monitoring systems across about 733 hectares of early-season rice fields. Operating around the clock, the systems provide digital monitoring of crop pests and diseases. The initiative has reduced pesticide use by 20%, achieved pest-control effectiveness of more than 90% and kept crop losses caused by pests and diseases below 5%. Farmers can use pest alerts sent to their phones to guide drones in applying pesticides precisely to affected areas. According to the report, this means even people without farming experience can carry out targeted pesticide application.
Meanwhile, smart agricultural machinery is changing how farms are managed. Xinhua News Agency reported in June 2026 that central China's Henan Province's agricultural machinery cloud platform had connected more than 138,000 machines. At an unmanned farm in Qingfeng County, Beidou navigation enables driverless harvesters to cover more than 13 hectares in a day.
A July report by Science and Technology Daily described an unmanned ratoon-rice farm in Datong Lake, central China's Hunan Province, where agricultural machinery guided by Beidou navigation operates alongside a digital management platform. Operating errors are kept within 2.5 centimeters. The 200-hectare rice farm requires only four people for management, while farmers' net income can exceed 30,000 yuan per hectare. The project has been selected as an Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations Asia-Pacific model case for smart agriculture.
AI is redefining precision farming, but food security depends on more than technological progress. It also means ensuring that the people who cultivate the land can share in the benefits of innovation.
articles.fullTextCn:
“今天创新，明天粮食安全”是周五举行的第46个世界粮食日的主题。随着人工智能（AI）从实验室走向田间，中国农业部门正经历从经验驱动向数据驱动耕作的转变。AI正在加速种子育种的进步。中国农业大学开发的“神农固芯”智能育种模型将基因型数据与农业知识图谱相结合，利用数千万条数据条目。该模型将育种周期缩短了30%以上，将开发新品种所需的时间从传统的五到八年减少到两到三年。

利用该模型开发的两个新莴苣品种——燕起1号和燕起2号——已在北京怀柔区成功试种，表现出较强的抗逆性和良好品质。AI还使田间管理更加精准。今年，中国东部浙江省龙泉市在约733公顷早季稻田部署了智能病虫害监测系统。

这些系统全天候运行，对作物病虫害进行数字化监测。该举措将农药使用量减少了20%，病虫害防治效果超过90%，病虫害造成的作物损失保持在5%以下。农民可以利用发送到手机的病虫害警报，引导无人机精准地对受影响区域施用农药。据报道，这意味着即使没有种植经验的人也能进行有针对性的农药施用。与此同时，智能农业机械正在改变农场的管理方式。

新华社2026年6月报道，中国中部河南省的农业机械云平台已连接超过13.8万台机器。在清丰县的一个无人农场，北斗导航使无人驾驶收割机一天能覆盖超过13公顷。7月《科技日报》的一篇报道描述了中国中部湖南省大通湖的一个无人再生稻农场，那里由北斗导航引导的农业机械与数字管理平台协同运作。操作误差控制在2.5厘米以内。这个200公顷的稻田只需四人管理，而农民的净收入每公顷可超过3万元。

articles.fullText:
(ECNS) – The 7th Genes & Diseases International Symposium and the 2026 International Conference on the Cooperation and Integration of Industry, Education, Research and Application (Chongqing Municipality, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan Provinces and Xizang Autonomous Region) Symposium on Biomedical Sciences were held at Chongqing Medical University on Friday.
Nearly 200 overseas experts from Sweden, the United States, Australia and other countries, as well as domestic representatives, attended the meetings.
The symposium is themed "Journal-led, Dual-mentor Empowerment: Building a New Industry-Education-Research-Application Ecosystem for Biomedicine." It is one of the events marking the 70th anniversary of Chongqing Medical University.
Yuan Jun, deputy secretary of the CPC Committee and vice president of Chongqing Medical University, said in his address that over the past 70 years, the university has become a nationally influential hub for medical education, a source of medical science and technology innovation, and a provider of high-quality medical services.
Yuan said biomedicine has become an important field in global technological competition. The symposium, by combining the development of high-level scientific journals with international industry-education-research-application cooperation, is of great significance.
Yuan hoped experts would use the event to strengthen exchanges and cooperation among universities, research institutes and enterprises in China and abroad, promote the deep integration of the education, talent, innovation and industrial chains, deepen international cooperation, and contribute wisdom and strength to the high-quality development of the biomedical industry.
Prof. T.-C. He (Tong-Chuan He), co-editor-in-chief of Genes & Diseases, said innovation in biomedicine is a systematic interaction among basic research, clinical translation, industrial application and talent cultivation.
He said that Southwest China has rich clinical resources, a solid industrial base, and growing research strength. He hoped the symposium would further pool academic, talent and industrial resources in Southwest China, deepen international exchanges and cooperation, and jointly build an open, collaborative and sustainable industry-education-research-application ecosystem.
The symposium includes parallel sessions on general medicine, stomatology and the dual-mentor program. Experts, international journal editors, university research teams, faculty and students held face-to-face discussions on biomaterial research and development, as well as collaborative talent cultivation.

articles.fullText:
A group of Chinese scientists has uncovered the mystery behind how an ancient gene regulates the development of brain folds, shedding new light on the evolution of the human brain. The findings were recently published in Nature Genetics.
The human brain is covered with intricate wrinkles and grooves, which constitute one of the important biological foundations for the emergence of advanced human cognitive functions. The traditional view holds that the expansion of the primate cerebral cortex was primarily driven by newly evolved genes.
However, a research team led by Shi Lei, a researcher from the Kunming Institute of Zoology under the Chinese Academy of Sciences, proposed an alternative possibility: certain ancient and highly conserved genes could also play a key role in human brain evolution by reshaping their expression levels through changes in regulatory elements.
The team compared transcriptomic data from different layers of the embryonic cerebral cortex of mice, tree shrews, marmosets, macaques and humans. They found that an ancient gene called "CCNB1IP1" was already expressed in the brain of the tree shrew, a close relative of primates, long before primates emerged but at relatively low expression levels.
The team further discovered that during the following course of evolution, the expression level of this ancient gene showed a clear stepwise increase among tree shrews, marmosets, macaques and humans, reaching its highest level in the human brain.
"The expression level of this ancient gene is closely correlated with the degree of cortical folding," said Shi, who noted that in marmosets, which have smooth brains, the expression level of this gene is similar to that in tree shrews. In macaques, whose brains have folds, the expression level is markedly elevated. In the human brain, this gene is expressed at the highest level.
Moreover, the team identified a key regulatory sequence, CRE1, that drives the elevated expression of CCNB1IP1.
To verify the gene's function, the team constructed a mouse model carrying the gene. The experiment showed that mice, which normally have a smooth cerebral cortex, developed cortical folding structures after the gene knock-in. Meanwhile, the modified mice exhibited enhanced learning and memory abilities in behavioral tests.
The team noted that this study not only provides a new perspective for understanding the evolution of the human brain, but also offers new clues for exploring the causes of neural development disorders.
